items.title: Aurora BP V3 research and validation
items.summary: Continue evaluating Aurora V3 through raw PPG, cuff-reference comparisons and participant-separated research. V3 remains the existing estimator while V4 runs independently for alpha comparison. Neither is clinically validated.

items.title: ECG and BP testing experience
items.summary: ECG reached public beta in June 2026, while experimental BP entered closed testing in early October. Continue improving recording, history, reporting, translations, phone-watch transfer and diagnostics, including comparisons of V3 and V4 against separately entered cuff references.

items.title: BP V4 Experimental: side-by-side alpha comparison
items.summary: Introduced V4 alongside Aurora V3 for controlled alpha comparisons using the same watch PPG recordings. V4 investigates personalized, quality-weighted calibration with three required and up to two optional references; the app can show separate estimates and differences from a nearby cuff reading. Early research has not shown V4 to be reliably more accurate than V3 or the cuff-only baseline. Neither model is clinically validated.

items.title: Expand independent BP validation
items.summary: Collect more paired watch-PPG and validated cuff measurements across different users and conditions, check high-pressure errors and calibration drift, and assess whether V3 or V4 offers dependable improvements. A more stable experimental release remains a hope, not a promise.

items.title: More wellness features after BP
items.summary: Return to additional sensor insights, health trends and other wellness ideas when the BP foundations are dependable. See the illustrated four-phase GitHub plan.
